name: elasticsearch
title: Elasticsearch
description: Send requests to Elasticsearch via Java Client API.
label: search,monitoring

properties.name: clusterName
properties.description: Name of the cluster

properties.name: connectionTimeout
properties.description: The time in ms to wait before connection will time out.

properties.name: disconnect
properties.description: Disconnect after it finish calling the producer

properties.name: enableDocumentOnlyMode
properties.description: Indicates whether the body of the message contains only documents. By default, it is set to false to be able to do the same requests as what the Document API supports (see https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/docs.html for more details). To ease the migration of routes based on the legacy component camel-elasticsearch-rest, you should consider enabling the mode, especially if your routes do update operations.

properties.name: from
properties.description: Starting index of the response.

properties.name: hostAddresses
properties.description: Comma separated list with ip:port formatted remote transport addresses to use.

properties.name: indexName
properties.description: The name of the index to act against

properties.name: maxRetryTimeout
properties.description: The time in ms before retry

properties.name: operation
properties.description: What operation to perform

properties.name: scrollKeepAliveMs
properties.description: Time in ms during which elasticsearch will keep search context alive

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size of the response.

properties.name: socketTimeout
properties.description: The timeout in ms to wait before the socket will time out.

properties.name: useScroll
properties.description: Enable scroll usage

properties.name: waitForActiveShards
properties.description: Index creation waits for the write consistency number of shards to be available

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: documentClass
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The class to use when deserializing the documents.

properties.name: enableSniffer
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Enable automatically discover nodes from a running Elasticsearch cluster. If this option is used in conjunction with Spring Boot, then it's managed by the Spring Boot configuration (see: Disable Sniffer in Spring Boot).

properties.name: sniffAfterFailureDelay
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The delay of a sniff execution scheduled after a failure (in milliseconds)

properties.name: snifferInterval
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The interval between consecutive ordinary sniff executions in milliseconds. Will be honoured when sniffOnFailure is disabled or when there are no failures between consecutive sniff executions

properties.name: certificatePath
properties.label: security
properties.description: The certificate that can be used to access the ES Cluster. It can be loaded by default from classpath, but you can prefix with classpath:, file:, or http: to load the resource from different systems.

properties.name: enableSSL
properties.label: security
properties.description: Enable SSL

properties.name: sslContextParameters
properties.label: security
properties.description: To configure security using SSLContextParameters. When configured, this takes precedence over the certificatePath option. This allows configuring named groups, signature schemes, cipher suites, and protocols for the TLS connection.
